id: \rNurse Joy: This cave can really tire you out. Take a break.
en: \rNurse Joy: This cave can really tire you out. Take a break.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Questa grotta può davvero sfinire. Riposati un po'.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now! The Pokémon here can be a little wild.
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now! The Pokémon here can be a little wild.
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto.  Abbi cura di te! I Pokémon qui possono essere un po' selvaggi.

id: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bGran bella lotta. Buona fortuna con il resto.

id: \bWhy are so many people in here?
en: \bWhy are so many people in here?
it: \bPerché c'è così tanta gente qui dentro?

id: \rI'm not going to lose to you.
en: \rI'm not going to lose to you.

id: \rWho would have thought. To a kid no less.
en: \rWho would have thought. To a kid no less.
it: \rChi l'avrebbe mai detto. Contro un ragazzino, per giunta.

id: \bIt's too cold. Take this away from me.
en: \bIt's too cold. Take this away from me.

id: \bI feel like I used to be a worst person.
en: \bI feel like I used to be a worst person.
it: \bHo come l'impressione di essere stato una persona peggiore.
